sources.title: raymond-van/gpt-tinystories | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The TinyStories dataset is a synthetic corpus of short stories generated by GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 using vocabulary understandable to a 4-year-old. This vocabulary constraint enables small models to achieve coherence that would be impossible with unrestricted datasets.
